messages.author: 7324f87aaa1afb0b
messages.subject: Re: Importing  regular txt
parts:
My code for importing data is provided below. Make sure you upload your data through www.movebank.org as this will format it in a way that CTMM can read. Once entered, download data as a .csv file. 

#Set working directory
setwd("C:/location on your computer where your .csv file is")       #Use / and not \ to separate 

#Import, coerce, and summarize MoveBank data
dataset<-as.telemetry("yourdataset.csv")

#Specify specific individual
individual1 <- dataset$individual1


Ross

Hi,

I would try to first import the text file with read.csv() and make sure that its importing correctly into a data.frame object with the right columns. You can then run as.telemetry() on the data.frame object.

But, as Ross suggested, getting your data through MoveBank is much preferred for making sure everything is setup correctly.

Best,
Chris
